name: Kibayama
source:
A humanoid brought into existence by Professor Kirazaki based on urban legends.
He is principled and innocent, but struggles with thinking and decision-making.

[From [url=https://s-digi.jp/lilim/02_soft/01_lilim/22_raimu/01-e.html] Official site[/url]]
